messages:
jess: Hey team, PR #4820 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4820. It adds KMS key selection for private/on-prem deployments and changes how KEY_ID is supplied (env or mounted secret). Requesting security review specifically for VPC/KMS egress surface and secrets scope. Planning to merge Wed 11:00 PST if no blockers.

sam: Thanks — will take a look this afternoon and check the auth surface.

alex: Quick question after a skim: does this ever fall back to the public KMS endpoint? I see logic that sets kms_client.host = os.getenv('KMS_HOST', 'public.kms.example.com') — that default is risky for private installs. Recommend failing fast when DEPLOY_ENV=="private" and KMS_HOST is unset. Also want to avoid silent network egress.

alex: ```py
# snippet from kms_client init
self.host = os.getenv('KMS_HOST', 'public.kms.example.com')
```

jess: Good catch. I left the fallback for hosted deployments so self-hosted folks wouldn't need extra config. Happy to gate it: if DEPLOY_ENV=="private" then require KMS_HOST or raise config error. Should I add a feature flag instead?

maria: We also need a brief rollout plan. Rotating keys or changing endpoints can cause transient failures. Suggest: canary to infra-staging (1 node), then small customer canary, then full. Also add a migration helper: tools/kms/migrate_keys.sh and doc snippet for ops.

alex: Also please narrow secret mounts — the current deploy yaml mounts the whole /etc/keys directory. Mount only the specific key file and limit filesystem perms. And add an audit log entry whenever a key is used (or annotate in existing audit pipeline). Finally add a unit test that asserts no public host is used when DEPLOY_ENV=private.

sam: I can add the unit test and a small KMS stub for CI. Will need jess to push the interface change so I can wire tests into CI.

deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #4820 added to merge queue at 3150202200. Estimated merge window Thu 02:30 UTC. Conflicts: none.

jess: Pushed updates: now assert KMS_HOST when DEPLOY_ENV=="private"; tightened mounts to a single file; added docs under docs/deploy/onprem-kms.md; created basic smoke test. PTAL @alex @sam.

alex: Reviewing now. Left two tiny nits inline about error messages — not blocking.

sam: CI green on unit + smoke. I ran the staging canary flow locally with the stub; behavior looks fine. LGTM from infra side.

sec-bot: sec-scan: static analysis flagged 'mount_secret: true' in deployment.yml (line 48). Please confirm minimal scope and that we avoid broader secret mounts.

jess: Acknowledged — I'll change to mount only /etc/keys/key-<id>.pem and remove mount_secret: true from the template, then push.

jess: Update: small follow-up pushed and tests re-run. Can I merge now or should we wait for @alex to finish review?

alex: No blockers, approving now. Added verification in CI to fail on public KMS host when DEPLOY_ENV=="private".

sam: I'll monitor the canary once merged.

sec-bot: policy-check: no high-severity alerts after latest push.

jess: Merged canary at 3150202500 and rolled to canary cluster. Canary passed smoke checks and audit logs look correct. Scheduling full rollout Thu 11:00 PST. Thanks all :tada:

jess: (follow-up) I'll open a short postmortem-style note in #eng-postmortems if anything unexpected shows up during the full rollout.
